questions.question: CI/CD nima va qaysi asosiy muammolarni hal qiladi?
questions.explanation: Continuous Integration va Continuous Delivery/Deployment. Build, test, packaging va deploy'ni avtomatlashtiradi: qo'l xatolari yo'qoladi, reliz sikli oylardan daqiqalarga qisqaradi, integratsiya bug'lari erta topiladi...

questions.question: Continuous Integration (CI) nima?
questions.explanation: Dasturchilar kodni umumiy repo'ga tez-tez (kuniga bir necha marta) commit qiladi; har commit avtomatik build, lint va unit/integration test'larni ishga tushirib, darhol feedback beradi.

questions.question: Continuous Delivery nima?
questions.explanation: CI kengaytmasi: kod avtomatik build, test qilinib production-ready holatga keltiriladi; prod'ga chiqarish esa aniq qo'lda biznes tasdiqini talab qiladi (tugma bosish).

questions.question: Continuous Deployment nima?
questions.explanation: To'liq avtomatlashgan reliz: barcha avtomatik test'lardan o'tgan har commit inson aralashuvisiz to'g'ridan-to'g'ri prod'ga chiqadi.

questions.question: Production CI/CD pipeline'ning asosiy bosqichlari qanday?
questions.explanation: Source trigger (webhook), 2. Statik tahlil va lint (SAST, secret scan), 3. Build, 4. Unit va integration test, 5. Artifact packaging va imzolash (Docker, SBOM, Cosign), 6. Staging deploy va DAST/E2E, 7. Prod'ga progre...

questions.question: CI/CD'da artifact nima?
questions.explanation: Build pipeline yaratgan compile qilingan, o'zgarmas deploy birligi (Docker image, JAR, NPM paket, Helm chart) — muhitlar bo'ylab promote qilinadi.

questions.question: "Build once, deploy anywhere" tamoyili nima?
questions.explanation: Kod CI'da bir marta o'zgarmas container/binary'ga yig'iladi va aynan shu binary Dev, Staging, Prod'ga deploy qilinadi; farq faqat runtime'da beriladigan config'da.

questions.question: CI/CD'da build matrix nima?
questions.explanation: OS (Ubuntu, macOS, Windows) va runtime versiyalari (Node 18, 20, 22) kombinatsiyalari bo'yicha bir nechta parallel job yaratuvchi konfiguratsiya.

questions.question: Pipeline caching va artifact storage farqi.
questions.explanation: Cache — keyingi build'larni tezlashtirish uchun vaqtinchalik dependency'lar (node_modules, Maven cache); artifact storage — output binary va hisobotlarni uzoq muddat saqlaydi.

questions.question: Semantic Versioning (SemVer) nima?
questions.explanation: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH (masalan 2.4.1): MAJOR — breaking change, MINOR — backward-compatible feature, PATCH — bug fix.

questions.question: Conventional Commits nima?
questions.explanation: Strukturali commit xabari spetsifikatsiyasi (feat:, fix:, chore:, feat!:) — Semantic Release kabi tool'lar versiyani avtomatik oshiradi va changelog yaratadi.

questions.question: Linter nima va nega erta ishlashi kerak?
questions.explanation: Kodni ishga tushirmasdan format, sintaksis va uslub qoidalarini tekshiradigan statik tahlil tool'i. Birinchi ishlasa — bir daqiqadan kam feedback, qimmat build vaqti tejaladi.

questions.question: CI/CD'da secret masking nima?
questions.explanation: Ro'yxatdan o'tgan secret qiymatlarini pipeline log'larida avtomatik  ga almashtirish — tasodifiy oqishning oldini olish (lekin base64 yoki bo'lingan qiymatni ushlamasligi mumkin).

questions.question: CI/CD'da webhook nima?
questions.explanation: Git platformasi (GitHub/GitLab) hodisa (push, PR ochildi) bo'lganda CI serverga yuboradigan HTTP POST callback — pipeline darhol ishga tushadi.

questions.question: Ephemeral / preview environment nima?
questions.explanation: PR ochilganda avtomatik yaratiladigan va merge/yopilganda o'chiriladigan qisqa muddatli izolyatsiyalangan muhit — feature'ni jonli sinash uchun.

questions.question: Canary deployment nima?
questions.explanation: Relizni real foydalanuvchilarning kichik qismiga (masalan 5%) chiqarish, error rate va latency'ni kuzatish va sog'lom bo'lsa trafikni bosqichma-bosqich 100% ga oshirish.

questions.question: Dark launching nima?
questions.explanation: Backend kodni prod'ga feature flag ortida butunlay yashirin chiqarish — UI ko'rsatmasdan jonli yuk ostida unumdorlik va DB so'rovlarini tekshirish.

questions.question: Feature flag (toggle) nima?
questions.explanation: Deploy'ni feature release'dan ajratuvchi shartli kod tarmog'i — API yoki UI orqali funksiyani bir zumda yoqish/o'chirish. Eski flag'larni tozalab turish kerak (texnik qarz).

questions.question: GitFlow nima?
questions.explanation: Uzoq yashovchi branch'lar (develop, feature, release, hotfix, master) modeli; ko'pincha merge conflict va sekin yetkazishga olib keladi. Versiyalangan (masalan, desktop/mobil) reliz'larda hali ham o'rinli.

questions.question: SAST nima?
questions.explanation: Whitebox xavfsizlik testi: source kodni compile'dan oldin zaifliklarga (SQL injection, buffer overflow, zaif kriptografiya) skanerlaydi.

questions.question: DAST nima?
questions.explanation: Blackbox xavfsizlik testi: ishlab turgan ilovaga tashqaridan hujum qilib, runtime zaifliklari, auth bypass va noto'g'ri konfiguratsiyalarni topadi.

questions.question: SCA (Software Composition Analysis) nima?
questions.explanation: Ochiq kodli third-party dependency'larni zaiflik bazalari (NVD, OSV) bo'yicha ma'lum CVE'larga tekshirish.

questions.question: CI'da mutation testing nima?
questions.explanation: Kodga ataylab kichik bug'lar (mutatsiyalar) kiritib, unit test'lar yiqiladimi tekshiriladi; test'lar o'tib ketsa — assertion'lar zaif.

questions.question: CI/CD'da concurrency control nima?
questions.explanation: PR branch'iga yangi commit push qilinganda eskirgan ishlab turgan pipeline'larni bekor qilish (cancel-in-progress: true) — resurs tejaladi; deploy'larda esa bir vaqtda faqat bittasi.

questions.question: GitHub'da merge queue nima?
questions.explanation: PR'larni navbatdagi oldingi PR'lar bilan kutilgan merge natijasiga nisbatan ketma-ket test qiladigan avtomatik tizim — main hech qachon buzilmaydi.

questions.question: Self-hosted runner va cloud-hosted runner farqi.
questions.explanation: Cloud-hosted — GitHub/GitLab to'liq boshqaradigan VM; self-hosted — sizning private VPC'ingizda, custom hardware, GPU va private tarmoqqa kirish bilan (xavfsizlik va yangilash sizning zimmangizda).

questions.question: Actions Runner Controller (ARC) nima?
questions.explanation: Kubernetes'da ephemeral GitHub Actions runner pod'larini webhook hodisalari asosida deploy va autoscale qiladigan operator.

questions.question: CI/CD'da OIDC nima?
questions.explanation: Federativ autentifikatsiya: runner JWT token bilan qisqa muddatli cloud credential (AWS STS / GCP IAM) oladi — statik API kalit saqlanmaydi.

questions.question: SBOM nima?
questions.explanation: Container yoki binary ichidagi barcha paket, kutubxona va tranzitiv dependency'larning mashina o'qiy oladigan rasmiy ro'yxati (SPDX, CycloneDX).

questions.question: Sigstore Cosign nima?
questions.explanation: OCI registry'dagi container image'larni (keyless OIDC bilan ham) kriptografik imzolash va tekshirish uchun ochiq kodli tool.

questions.question: SLSA framework nima?
questions.explanation: Supply-chain Levels for Software Artifacts — build platformasi izolyatsiyasi, soxtalashtirib bo'lmaydigan provenance va source yaxlitligi standartlarini belgilovchi xavfsizlik framework'i.

questions.question: Hermetic build nima?
questions.explanation: Tashqi internetsiz sandbox'da bajariladigan build: barcha dependency'lar oldindan olingan va hash bilan qotirilgan — 100% reproducible.

questions.question: Docker BuildKit layer caching nima?
questions.explanation: Oraliq build layer'larini remote OCI registry'da cache'lash (--cache-to/--cache-from type=registry) — ephemeral CI runner'lar mustaqil build'larda ularni qayta ishlatadi.

questions.question: SonarQube Quality Gate nima?
questions.explanation: Kod sifati chegaralarini (masalan coverage ≥ 80%, 0 kritik zaiflik) majburlovchi siyosat — bajarilmasa PR merge bloklanadi.

questions.question: Code coverage nima?
questions.explanation: Test'lar ishlaganda bajarilgan source kod foizi (JaCoCo, Istanbul, pytest-cov). Yuqori coverage sifatli test degani emas.

questions.question: Pipeline as Code nima?
questions.explanation: CI/CD workflow, build qadamlari va muhitlar versiyalanadigan deklarativ fayllarda (.github/workflows/.yml, .gitlab-ci.yml, Jenkinsfile).

questions.question: Monorepo CI strategiyasi qanday?
questions.explanation: Path filter va dependency graph tool'lari (Turborepo, Nx, Bazel) — commit faqat o'zgargan servis va unga bog'liqlarni qayta build/test qiladi.

questions.question: Pull-through cache nima?
questions.explanation: VPC ichidagi lokal registry (Harbor, ECR Pull Through Cache) public image'larni cache'laydi — tashqi rate limit (Docker Hub) va tashqi bog'liqlik yo'qoladi.

questions.question: CI/CD'da Automated Canary Analysis (ACA) nima?
questions.explanation: Prometheus/Datadog so'rovlari bilan canary va baseline pod'lar error rate'ini statistik solishtirib, anomaliyada avtomatik rollback.

questions.question: Flagger nima?
questions.explanation: Istio, Linkerd yoki Nginx Ingress bilan canary routing va metrika tahlilini avtomatlashtiradigan CNCF progressive delivery operatori.

questions.question: Argo Rollouts nima?
questions.explanation: Kubernetes controller: canary, blue-green va eksperimentlar, avtomatik metrika tekshiruvi (AnalysisTemplate) bilan.

questions.question: ArgoCD nima?
questions.explanation: Kubernetes uchun deklarativ GitOps CD tool'i: Git'dagi desired state'ni klasterdagi live state bilan doimiy reconcile qiladi, drift'ni ko'rsatadi.

questions.question: FluxCD nima?
questions.explanation: Modulli, UI'siz Kubernetes GitOps toolkit: klaster holatini Git repo va Helm chart'lardan avtomatik sinxronlaydi.

questions.question: Tekton nima?
questions.explanation: Kubernetes CRD'lari (Task, Pipeline) asosida moslashuvchan CI/CD pipeline qurish uchun cloud-native framework.

questions.question: Spinnaker nima?
questions.explanation: Netflix yaratgan ochiq kodli multi-cloud CD platformasi — AWS, GCP, Kubernetes bo'ylab murakkab ko'p bosqichli deploy pipeline'lar.

questions.question: Gitleaks nima?
questions.explanation: Pre-commit hook va CI'da commit qilingan API kalit, token va private key'larni topadigan tez secret scanner.

questions.question: Trivy nima?
questions.explanation: Container image, fayl tizimi, Git repo va Kubernetes/IaC konfiguratsiyalari uchun keng qamrovli zaiflik skaneri.
